current_state_evidence.observation: Any replay state containing a response_id currently wins unconditionally and serializes only messages after that assistant anchor.
The only current guard is whether Responses transport is selected; provider support for durable previous_response_id state is not represented.
The native Codex adapter already has a distinct construction boundary that can explicitly opt into server-managed response chaining.
The existing test asserts response-id chaining for a generic third-party endpoint, encoding the overly broad behavior.
After tool_search returned get_current_time plus activation instructions, the next Responses iteration reported previous_response_id with zero replayed reasoning items and lost the original task.

control_flow.failure_path: A tool result is appended locally, but the next backend request may omit the original user task.
Responses payload construction chooses response-id chaining without a provider capability contract.
messages before the response-id anchor are omitted for a provider that does not preserve them.
The provider accepts the request but answers without the original obligation, producing a false ordinary-chat continuation.

invariants.statement: A generic OpenAI-compatible Responses backend must replay the complete local non-system history on every follow-up unless an explicit construction-time capability opts into server-managed response chaining.
invariants.enforcement_owner: OpenAICompatBackend continuity policy and Responses input serializer
invariants.prohibited_behavior: Inferring server-managed continuity merely from a response_id, GPT-like model name, provider hostname, explicit /responses path, or a successful basic tool-protocol probe.
invariants.counterexample: A third-party /responses endpoint returns resp_prev after tool_search but does not persist the original user request; the follow-up must contain the original user item, assistant function_call, function_call_output, and current continuation without previous_response_id.
phase_exit: generic provider payload contains complete ordered history
strict runtime tool flow reaches the requested concrete tool or a structured blocker without forgetting the task

invariants.statement: A native adapter that explicitly declares previous_response_id support may continue to send only post-anchor items plus previous_response_id.
invariants.enforcement_owner: OpenAICodexBackend construction and OpenAICompatBackend continuity policy
invariants.prohibited_behavior: Disabling native response-id chaining globally while repairing generic compatibility behavior.
invariants.counterexample: OpenAICodexBackend receives a replay anchor followed by a tool result; its payload must retain previous_response_id and exclude pre-anchor history.

invariants.statement: Continuity selection must be a closed-set explicit capability contract with a safe local-replay default, not an open-world string heuristic.
invariants.enforcement_owner: Typed Responses continuity policy accepted by backend construction
invariants.prohibited_behavior: Adding URL, provider, model, language, or error-message substring lists as the source of truth.
invariants.counterexample: Two unrelated hostnames and two model names both return response IDs; both remain local-replay unless the adapter passes the explicit native capability.
phase_exit: variant and negative tests defeat hostname/model hardcoding

invariants.statement: The existing tool_search to tool_activate policy gate and schema refresh contract must remain unchanged while Responses continuity is repaired.
invariants.enforcement_owner: Existing tool activation runtime and its regression suite
invariants.prohibited_behavior: Bypassing tool_activate, broadening tool exposure, or special-casing get_current_time to mask the continuity defect.
invariants.counterexample: A hidden write or time tool found through discovery must still require the existing policy-approved activation path; only the conversation context transport changes.
phase_exit: tool activation contract tests remain green
runtime activation flow preserves the original request
